crossRefs.note: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will…
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a…

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
translations.bsb: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come closer so I can touch you, my son. Are you really my son Esau, or not?”
translations.kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau
translations.asv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
